Committee: Finance and Taxation Education
Sponsor: Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 03/09/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 298 as introduced amends several provisions of the Alabama Innovation Act to: (1) provide that an Alabama research entity must create a partnership with a private sector applicant to receive grant funds; (2) establish a competitive scoring system for the awarding of future research and development grants; and (3) provide $1 of grant funds for each non-state dollar for a faculty and student intern partnership program. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Arthur Orr, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation Education

Committee: Ways and Means Education
Sponsor: Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 03/29/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 298 as passed the Senate amends the Alabama Innovation Act to: (1) provide that an Alabama research entity must create a partnership with a private sector applicant to receive grant funds; (2) establish a competitive scoring system for the awarding of future research and development grants; (3) provide dollar-for-dollar grant funds for non-state matching funds for a faculty and student intern partnership program; and (4) revises how the maximum grant award amount is calculated. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Bill Poole, Chair
Ways and Means Education
